name: tjs-platform-functions

scripts.build:transpile: cd .. && for f in functions/src/*.tjs; do bun src/cli/tjs.ts emit "$f" > "${f%.tjs}.js" || { echo "transpile FAILED: $f" >&2; rm -f "${f%.tjs}.js"; exit 1; }; done
scripts.build: npm run build:version && npm run build:transpile && npm run build:bundle
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions
scripts.build:version: node -e "const v=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('node_modules/tjs-lang/package.json','utf8')).version;require('fs').writeFileSync('src/version.js','// GENERATED by build:version — the tjs-lang this bundle was built against.\\n'+'export const TJS_LANG_VERSION = '+JSON.stringify(v)+'\\n')"
